title: AI辅助优化下的探索性响应与适应性僵化
summary: 本文提出了一种在AI辅助优化下的探索性适应理论。核心论点是AI系统的长期适应效果取决于预测性辅助如何与探索性响应相互作用。通过动态框架形式化该机制，指出在收敛性预测机制下，AI会替代探索性参与，降低适应性响应，导致系统局部高效但全局僵化。同时，也识别了探索增强机制。长期效果取决于制度结构、发展背景和人机交互架构。
summary_en: This paper develops a theory of exploratory adaptation under AI-assisted optimization, arguing that AI's long-run adaptive effects depend on how predictive assistance interacts with exploratory responsiveness. It formalizes a dynamical framework showing that convergent predictive regimes can reduce adaptive responsiveness, causing metastable trapping and exploration-collapse, while also identifying exploration-enhancing regimes.
